status: Valid short-run performance result; matched GPU scaling, long-run stability and checkpoint acceptance remain pending

audit.policy_publications: Versions 1 through 26, each to all 64 replicas
audit.quality_scope: Execution and reward correctness only; no claim about convergence or perceptual speech-quality improvement

timing.method: Adjacent driver generate starts; exclude first three updates and final unclosed interval; includes generation, rewards, artifacts/conversion, training and weight publication, excludes initialization

asr8_control.resource_scope: GPU-seconds use allocated learner/rollout plus ASR GPUs during measured steady steps only; exclude initialization, queueing and inter-case scaling, and are not a monetary cost estimate
asr8_control.instrumentation_difference: ASR16 uses error-only transport diagnostics 3a5dd4e7 instead of 0655097d. Successful requests do not log; pool, routing, timeout, retries and publication behavior are unchanged. This is not a byte-identical router control.
asr8_control.interpretation: After the router bottleneck was reduced, ASR replicas improve end-to-end throughput by 12.3%, not 2x. This is an ASR scaling comparison with 64 learner/rollout GPUs held fixed, not the 32-to-64 GPU scaling factor. Separate-run means are descriptive, not statistical significance.

remaining_bottleneck_evidence.boundary_scope: The 4.08-second difference includes artifact/metric logging, batch conversion/splitting, serving completion and RPC-boundary overhead; individual contributions were not separately timed. The 5.87-second last-response tail also includes reward completion. These overlapping quantities must not be added or labeled pure ASR/GPU time.
remaining_bottleneck_evidence.gpu_scope: GPU utilization is averaged over whole steady steps, including idle training/serving phases; low whole-step utilization is not evidence that GPU kernels are intrinsically inefficient.
remaining_bottleneck_evidence.profile: One run-scoped busy data plane, final excluded rollout 24, 5 seconds, 145 successful GIL-held samples and 39 errors; hot frames include HTTP connection-pool scanning and H11 relay. Fractions are not wall-clock shares or an all-data-plane census.

stability_caveat: Two prior four-router-process attempts failed with upstream ReadError/HTTP502 on different workers. They remain invalid and are not included in accepted performance comparisons. Error-only diagnostics are not a transport fix, and this 25-update eight-process success is not proof of long-run immunity.
